identity.carried_by: HTTP request headers added by ROMChat; never a tool argument and never the MCP session id
identity.shared_secret: when configured on the server, a missing or wrong secret is treated as no identity
identity.without_trusted_identity: the tool still runs but its result is never cached

tools.description: Compare CXOne metrics for a target historical period (one local day, or part of one) against a baseline of the same window on prior weeks. Returns target and baseline values, deltas, the normal range, baseline coverage (requested/available/excluded/used) and the largest-moving skills. Historical only; live queue state is in current_state. Every response carries `temporal` (requested vs covered period, timezone), `quality` (availability, completeness, freshness, basis) and `claim_limits`; describe what changed, never why - no cause, schedule or staffing explanation is established by these data.

baseline_weeks.description: Number of prior weekly baseline periods (1-26). Default 8 (accepted by the business; the wider baseline policy is still being confirmed).
baseline_weeks.title: Baseline Weeks

end.description: Exclusive period end, ISO-8601 WITH a UTC offset. Must be after start, not in the future, and on the same local day as start or exactly local midnight of the next day. Multi-day periods are rejected.
end.title: End

latest_complete.description: If true, report the LATEST interval that is verified complete instead of an explicit start/end (mutually exclusive with start/end). Use it for 'right now' KPI questions. The response states the interval end, its age and the completeness basis; reporting lag was about 16 minutes in one measurement and may vary. If no interval can be verified complete the call returns COMPLETENESS_UNVERIFIED rather than a guess.
latest_complete.title: Latest Complete

metrics.description: Metric names to report (at least one). Supported: abandon_rate, abandoned_contacts, average_handle_time, average_speed_of_answer, contacts_handled, contacts_offered, service_level, voicemails. Duplicates are removed and names are lower-cased.
metrics.title: Metrics

reporting_timezone.description: REQUIRED reporting timezone as an IANA name (e.g. 'America/New_York') used to interpret day boundaries. It is never defaulted to UTC and must match the configured business timezone.
reporting_timezone.title: Reporting Timezone

skill_ids.description: Optional skill IDs. Sorted and de-duplicated. Omit to use the configured skill scope. IDs outside the configured scope are rejected. An empty list is rejected.
skill_ids.title: Skill Ids

start.description: Inclusive period start, ISO-8601 WITH a UTC offset, e.g. '2026-09-01T00:00:00-04:00' or '...Z'. Periods are half-open: [start, end). The period must lie within ONE local calendar day of reporting_timezone. Required together with end unless latest_complete is true.
start.title: Start

tools.name: compare_periods

tools.description: Live snapshot of queue depth and observed agent counts per skill, with the observation timestamp. Live data only: a timestamped observation, never a current-by-default figure, a historical staffing estimate or a schedule. Per-skill agent counts are not a distinct headcount. Every response carries `temporal` (requested vs covered period, timezone), `quality` (availability, completeness, freshness, basis) and `claim_limits`; describe what changed, never why - no cause, schedule or staffing explanation is established by these data.

skill_ids.description: Optional skill IDs. Sorted and de-duplicated. Omit to use the configured skill scope. IDs outside the configured scope are rejected. An empty list is rejected.
skill_ids.title: Skill Ids

tools.name: current_state

Reuses data already fetched by a preceding compare_periods in the same conversation. Every response carries `temporal` (requested vs covered period, timezone), `quality` (availability, completeness, freshness, basis) and `claim_limits`; describe what changed, never why - no cause, schedule or staffing explanation is established by these data.

include_series.title: Include Series
